description: This file defines a Java class that implements an exception mapper for PlatformDataIntegrityException within the Fineract project. It maps specific exceptions to HTTP responses in a REST API context, handling data integrity errors.

classes.name: PlatformDataIntegrityExceptionMapper
classes.description: A class that implements an exception mapper for PlatformDataIntegrityException, converting it into an HTTP response with a data integrity error message.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a PlatformDataIntegrityException into a JAX-RS Response object with a 403 Forbidden status and a JSON body describing the error.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns the specific error code (3001) associated with data integrity errors.
